newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Seagram debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Seagram debt ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday it reaffirmed the ratings of Seagram Co Ltd bonds and debentures at A+(Low) and its commercial paper at A-1+, all with a stable rating outlook.
"Despite declining worldwide consumption of spirits and wines, the company's beverage margins remain strong, while sales of the flagship Tropicana orange juice brand are robust," the agency said.

"The general risks found in the entertainment business are mitigated by a portfolio-based approach to the production and acquisition of films, as well as the company's growing presence in the music and recreation businesses," it added.
